title: Codex Apps MCP fails only under Dreadnought kernel

observed: Dreadnought v0.2.0b5 originally failed with: bwrap: Can't mkdir /etc/codex: Read-only file system.
Branch fix/codex-etc-mountpoint changes the Codex requirements mount strategy so the kernel can start without requiring a host /etc/codex directory.
After that fix, Codex starts inside Dreadnought but codex_apps MCP fails during initialize against https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/ps/mcp with an HTTP request transport error.
Launching plain codex outside Dreadnought on the same machine loads successfully, so the remaining MCP failure is specific to the Dreadnought kernel environment rather than a general Codex outage.
semantic.next_action: Compare the environment and network-visible runtime between plain Codex and PrimaryKernel. In particular verify proxy/TLS-related environment variables and DNS/CA visibility before changing policy. Preserve Dreadnought's outer Bubblewrap authority boundary and do not re-enable Codex UnifiedExec.
semantic.known_separate_issue: src/dreadnought/__init__.py still hardcodes __version__ = 0.2.0b3, causing installed b5 to report the stale installed version. This is independent of the MCP runtime failure.
